title: Page 4
content_zh:
梁浩海挑眉，眼中隐隐有欣赏，为了这姑娘的冷静爽快，也为了她的孝心。
童悠悠却不再看他，直接扯了棉被裹在身上。
梁浩海同冯全点点头，然后弯腰把童悠悠扛在肩上，跳出窗子，没入黑夜。
城里城外一片安静，唯一的动静就是更夫的梆子声了。
童家大院里，一如他们离开时候的样子，并没有人发现自家小姐出去逛了一圈儿，包括睡在脚踏上的小桃。
梁浩海跳进窗子，把童悠悠放在床上，童悠悠被颠得晕头转向，依旧没忘了抓着梁浩海的衣袖，“我的丫鬟怎么办？留下解药！”
梁浩海忍不住轻笑，低声道：“放心，她只是睡得沉，明早就会醒来。”
“多谢，”童悠悠走去窗边，
梁浩海笑得更厉害，暗夜里看见一口白牙。
这姑娘不但胆子大、心善，还有点儿小聪明，这是防备他起了色心，站在窗户边随时可以呼救，或者跳楼躲避。
折腾一晚，他到底心里有些愧疚，没再吓唬她，拱拱手，就跳了出去。
童悠悠等了半晌，听得外边再无一丝动静，才小心探头看了看，然后紧紧关了窗户。
待重新坐到床上，她才后怕起来。
幸好，这两人只是抓了她帮忙救人，万一心存歹意……那她今晚就玩完了。
不过，江湖人真是自由，飞檐走壁，若是她没有学医，去学武艺，是不是就不用日日困在这个大院子里……
这般胡思乱想，童悠悠实在困倦不堪，换了一套中衣，怀里藏着的那根铜管突然掉出来，发出清脆的声音，吓得她赶紧捡起来。
那姑娘死前把这铜管给了她，显见是不想给那两个人，但两个人又极力想救那姑娘的命，这其中到底有什么事呢？
童悠悠有些头疼，生怕给家里惹了麻烦，毕竟童家大院只有她和祖母，万一有事，后悔就来不及了。可当时她把铜管收下，如今反悔也晚了，索性把铜管扔进妆盒，藏好替换下来的衣物，便重新睡下。
这一觉香甜至极，直到小桃把她摇晃醒来，她还有些发懵。
“小姐，小姐！不好了，老夫人发病了，陈管家已经去请王大夫了，您快去看看。”

老夫人，王大夫？
童悠悠糊涂的脑袋终于清醒了，翻身下床，“什么时候的事？祖母咳嗽得厉害吗？”
陈嫂子这会儿也赶到了，一边帮着小桃伺候主子穿衣裙，一边禀告，“小姐，老夫人……这次怕是不太好，您要有个准备，听说……听说老夫人大口吐血……”
童悠悠白了脸，祖母是多年咳疾，放到现代就是肺部方面的重症，她已经在家里严格规定祖母的吃穿用度，更是想尽所有办法治疗、调养，终究徒劳无功。
从去年开始，祖母就时不时咳血。教授她医术的王大夫原本是宫里太医致仕归乡，本事了得，但对于祖母的病也是束手无策。上次来家里诊脉的时候，王大夫就提醒过，祖母怕是时日无多了。
不想，这才一个月，祖母就又吐血了。
童悠悠担心得很，带人快步赶去主院。
第二章 最后的叮咛(2)
童老夫人常年卧床养病，主院伺候的丫鬟仆役们已经习惯了。但方才睡梦中的童老夫人突然咳嗽吐血严重，还是把大家都吓到了，这会儿除了近身伺候的丫鬟，其余都在廊檐下翘首盼望。
待见到大小姐赶来，他们都松了一大口气，终于有主心骨儿了。
童悠悠来不及安慰众人，赶紧进屋去探望祖母，屋里的血腥味道还没有散去，童老夫人躺在床上面如白纸，重重喘息，不时声嘶力竭的咳嗽着，听得人心都跟着揪了起来。
“祖母您怎么样了？坚持一下，王大夫马上就来了！”童悠悠红了眼圈，握着祖母的手。
童老夫人想要说话，但嗓子里的腥甜却让她张不开嘴。
童悠悠赶紧安慰祖母，“祖母先不要说话，喝口水，润润嗓子。”
说罢，她就把童老夫人扶了起来，亲手端了凉茶，童老夫人喝了两口，脸色终于好了一些。
她又喊来老夫人的贴身大丫鬟茉莉，吩咐道：“茉莉，赶紧让灶间煮参汤。”
茉莉是在老夫人身边伺候了五六年的大丫鬟，平日很得老夫人信重，对老夫人忠心耿耿，这会儿也红了眼圈哽咽应道：“小姐放心，奴婢早就吩咐下去，一会儿参汤就能端来。”
果然，她的话音刚刚落下，陈嫂子就端了参汤，从门外进来了。
童悠悠赶紧又给祖母喂了几口，童老夫人摆手勉强道：“好啦，一会儿再喝。”
她还想再说几句的时候，有个小丫头在门外禀告，“小姐，王大夫到了。”

“快请，快请王大夫进来！”童悠悠放下祖母，亲自迎到门口。
许是来得匆忙，王大夫有些喘，就是后面拎着药箱的小药童都走得踉踉跄跄。
“王大夫，又辛苦您跑一趟。”童悠悠感到过意不去，王大夫如今六十多岁，若不是因为两家交情好，又有她这半个徒弟的情分，老大夫实在不必半夜如此奔波出诊。
王大夫摆摆手，好不容易喘匀了气道：“自家人不必客气，我先看看老夫人的病。”
童悠悠赶忙让开位置，王大夫上前拿起了童老夫人的左手，开始诊脉。好半晌，他才把老夫人的手腕放下，语气轻松说道：“放心吧，没有大事。不过是春夏交替的气息变化，才惹得老夫人咳嗽重了些，我开一张药方，吃上三日就好了。”
屋里的丫鬟闻言都露出喜色，只有茉莉眼圈依旧是红红的。
王大夫招呼童悠悠，“大小姐，随我来，我开药方，大小姐也帮我看一下。”
虽然没有正式拜师，但王大夫确实是童悠悠的半个师傅，两人这几年经常如此，众人已经习惯了。
童悠悠为祖母掖了掖被角，嘱咐几句之后走到门外，却见王大夫脸色凝重。
廊檐下只有他们两人，王大夫抛开那些规矩，压低声音同童悠悠道：“悠悠，你要早做准备了，老夫人的大限怕是就在这几日了。”
童悠悠的眼泪顿时落了下来，恳求道：“师傅，不能再想想办法吗？哪怕再让祖母延寿一个月都好。”
王大夫叹气摇头，“老夫人卧床多年，身体已经到了极限，不可强求。强求的话，老夫人要遭受很多苦楚，不如就这样吧。”
童悠悠知道王大夫但凡有一点办法也不会如此说，她只能擦干眼泪给王大夫行了一礼，“多谢师傅，我知道了，还请师傅给祖母开一服药让她不至于那么难受。”
“我明白，你不用多说，好好照顾你祖母，陪她走完最后几日。”王大夫叹道，不只是因为童老夫人即将过世，更心疼童悠悠这半个女徒弟以后要如何生活。
童悠悠却无暇顾及这么多，喊了站在院门口的陈管家上前，“陈叔，请带王大夫去开药方。”
陈管家赶紧应声，“是，小姐。”
童悠悠擦干眼泪，藏好眼里的悲伤，转身进屋。
不知是不是回光返照，童老夫人比起方才居然脸色好了很多。
眼见孙女进来，她吩咐茉莉，“去帮我熬药汤。”
茉莉猜到主子有话要说，行了一礼就下去了。

童老夫人拍了拍床沿喊着孙女，“悠悠，到这儿来坐。”
童悠悠赶紧快步上前拉着祖母的手，笑道：“祖母，我师傅说了，喝过三日药汤您就不会咳嗽得太厉害，过几天城外花开，我陪您出去踏春？”
content_en:
Liang Haohai raised his eyebrows, with a hint of appreciation in his eyes, for the girl's calmness and cheerfulness, and for her filial piety.
Tong Youyou stopped looking at him and directly pulled the quilt around her body.
Liang Haohai nodded with Feng Quan, then bent down and carried Tong Youyou on his shoulders, jumped out of the window and disappeared into the night.
It was quiet outside the city, and the only sound was the sound of the watchman's bang.
In the Tong Family Courtyard, it was just like when they left. No one noticed that their young lady had gone out for a walk, including Xiao Tao who was sleeping on the footrest.
Liang Haohai jumped into the window and put Tong Youyou on the bed. Tong Youyou was so dizzy that she still didn't forget to grab Liang Haohai's sleeve, "What should I do with my maid? Leave the antidote!"
Liang Haohai couldn't help but chuckle and whispered: "Don't worry, she is just sleeping deeply and will wake up tomorrow morning."
"Thank you," Tong Youyou walked to the window.
Liang Haohai smiled even harder and saw a set of white teeth in the dark night.
This girl is not only brave and kind-hearted, but also a little clever. This is to prevent him from becoming lustful. She can call for help at any time by standing by the window, or jump off the building to escape.
After struggling all night, he finally felt a little guilty, so he didn't scare her anymore, just handed her over and jumped out.
Tong Youyou waited for a long time, and when she heard no more movement outside, she carefully took a look, and then closed the window tightly.
It wasn't until she sat down on the bed again that she became scared.
Fortunately, these two people only captured her to help save people. If they had evil intentions... then she would be finished tonight.
However, Jianghu people are really free. If she had not studied medicine but martial arts, wouldn't she have to be trapped in this big courtyard every day...
Tong Youyou was so sleepy with such random thoughts that she changed into a pair of middle clothes. The copper pipe hidden in her arms suddenly fell out and made a crisp sound, which scared her and quickly picked it up.
The girl gave the copper pipe to her before she died. It was obvious that she didn't want to give it to the two men, but the two men tried their best to save the girl's life. What was going on in this?
Tong Youyou has a headache and is afraid of causing trouble for her family. After all, there are only her and her grandmother in the Tong family compound. If something happens, it will be too late to regret. But she accepted the copper pipe at that time, but now it was too late to regret it. She simply threw the copper pipe into the dressing box, hid the replacement clothes, and went to sleep again.
The sleep was extremely sweet, and she was still a little dazed until Xiaotao shook her awake.
"Miss, miss! It's not good, the old lady is ill. Butler Chen has already sent for Dr. Wang. Please go and have a look."
Old lady, Doctor Wang?
Tong Youyou's confused head finally came to her senses, and she turned over and got out of bed, "When did it happen? Did grandma have a bad cough?"
Sister-in-law Chen also arrived at this moment. While helping Xiao Tao to dress her master, she reported, "Miss, old lady... I'm afraid it won't go well this time. You have to be prepared. I heard... I heard that the old lady was vomiting blood..."
Tong Youyou's face turned pale. Her grandmother had been suffering from a cough for many years, which in modern times was a severe lung problem. She had strictly regulated her grandmother's food and clothing expenses at home, and tried every means to treat and nurse her back to health, but in the end, all was in vain.
Since last year, my grandmother has been coughing up blood from time to time. Doctor Wang, who taught her medical skills, was originally a palace physician who returned to his hometown after serving as an official. He was very capable, but he was also helpless about her grandmother's illness. The last time he came to the house for pulse diagnosis, Doctor Wang reminded her that my grandmother might not have much time left.
Unexpectedly, just one month later, my grandmother was vomiting blood again.
Tong Youyou was very worried and hurried to the main courtyard with her people.
Chapter 2 Final Instructions (2)
Mrs. Tong has been in bed all year round to recuperate, and the maids and servants serving in the main hospital have become accustomed to it. But Mrs. Tong, who had been sleeping just now, suddenly coughed and vomited blood severely, which still frightened everyone. Now, except for the maid who was waiting nearby, everyone else was looking forward to it under the eaves.
When they saw the eldest lady arriving, they all breathed a sigh of relief, finally having a backbone.Tong Youyou didn't have time to comfort everyone, so she hurried into the house to visit her grandmother. The smell of blood in the room had not dissipated. Mrs. Tong lay on the bed like a white paper, breathing heavily, coughing hoarsely from time to time, which made people's hearts tremble.
"Grandma, how are you? Hold on, Doctor Wang will be here soon!" Tong Youyou's eyes were red and she held her grandmother's hand.
Mrs. Tong wanted to speak, but the sweetness in her throat prevented her from opening her mouth.
Tong Youyou quickly comforted her grandmother, "Grandma, don't talk yet. Drink some water to moisten your throat."
After saying that, she helped Mrs. Tong up and served the herbal tea with her own hands. Mrs. Tong took two sips and her complexion finally improved.
She then called the old lady's personal maid Jasmine and ordered: "Jasmine, hurry up and let the stove cook the ginseng soup."
Jasmine is the maid who has been serving the old lady for five or six years. She usually has the old lady's trust and is loyal to her. Now she responded with red eyes and choked with sobs: "Don't worry, young lady, I've already given the order, and the ginseng soup will be served shortly."
Sure enough, as soon as she finished speaking, Sister-in-law Chen came in from the door with ginseng soup.
Tong Youyou quickly fed her grandmother a few more mouthfuls. Mrs. Tong waved her hands and said reluctantly: "Okay, I'll drink it later."
When she wanted to say a few more words, a little girl announced outside the door, "Miss, Doctor Wang is here."
"Please, please come in, Doctor Wang!" Tong Youyou put down her grandmother and went to the door in person.
Maybe he came in a hurry, Doctor Wang was a little out of breath, and even the little medicine boy carrying the medicine box behind him was staggering.
"Doctor Wang, it's hard for you to make another trip." Tong Youyou felt sorry. Dr. Wang is now over sixty years old. If it weren't for the good relationship between the two families and her half-apprentice relationship, the old doctor really wouldn't have to run around to see patients in the middle of the night.
Doctor Wang waved his hand and finally managed to catch his breath and said, "You don't have to be polite, I'll check on the old lady's illness first."
Tong Youyou quickly got out of the way, and Doctor Wang stepped forward and picked up Mrs. Tong's left hand and began to diagnose her pulse. After a long while, he put down the old lady's wrist and said in a relaxed tone: "Don't worry, it's nothing serious. It's just the change of breath between spring and summer that made the old lady cough more severely. I'll write a prescription and take it for three days and it will be fine."
The maids in the room all looked happy when they heard this, but Jasmine's eye circles were still red.
Doctor Wang called to Tong Youyou, "Miss, come with me. I'll prescribe the medicine, and Miss will also look at it for me."
Although he did not officially become a master, Doctor Wang was indeed half of Tong Youyou's master. The two of them had often been like this in the past few years, and everyone was used to it.
Tong Youyou tucked her grandmother in, gave a few instructions and walked out the door, only to see Doctor Wang's face solemn.
There were only two of them under the eaves of the corridor. Doctor Wang put aside those rules and lowered his voice and said to Tong Youyou: "Yuyou, you should make preparations early. I am afraid that the old lady's deadline is within these few days."
Tong Youyou's tears suddenly fell down, and she begged: "Master, can't you think of another way? Even if it can extend my grandmother's life for another month."
Doctor Wang sighed and shook his head, "The old lady has been in bed for many years, and her body has reached its limit. Don't force it. If you force it, the old lady will suffer a lot, so it's better to leave it like this."
Tong Youyou knew that Dr. Wang would not say this if she had any choice. She could only wipe away her tears and salute Dr. Wang, "Thank you, master. I understand. I also ask the master to prescribe some medicine for my grandmother so that she will not feel so uncomfortable."
"I understand. You don't need to say anything. Take good care of your grandmother and accompany her through the last few days." Doctor Wang sighed, not only because Mrs. Tong was about to pass away, but also because he felt sorry for how Tong Youyou, the female apprentice, would live in the future.
Tong Youyou had no time to take care of so much, so she called Butler Chen who was standing at the entrance of the hospital to come forward, "Uncle Chen, please take Doctor Wang to write a prescription."
Butler Chen quickly responded,"Yes, miss."
Tong Youyou wiped away her tears, hid the sadness in her eyes, and turned around to enter the house.
I don't know if it was because of the flashback, but Mrs. Tong actually looked much better than before.
Seeing her granddaughter come in, she told Jasmine, "Go and help me make the medicinal soup."
Jasmine guessed that her master had something to say, so she bowed and left.
Mrs. Tong patted the edge of the bed and called her granddaughter, "Yuyou, come and sit here."
Tong Youyou hurried forward, took her grandmother's hand, and said with a smile: "Grandma, my master said that after three days of drinking the medicinal soup, you won't cough too much. In a few days, the flowers outside the city will bloom. Can I go out with you for a spring outing?"
